creature_families: Monster templates, type Monster: 2336 (levels 1 to 87; peak in 70-89 band)
Race enum (L2Dn.GameServer.Enums/Race.cs) lists monster families: animal, beast, bug, construct, demonic, divine, dragon, elemental, fairy, giant, humanoid, plant, siege, undead

Keyword hits in NPC names (approximate, not per-family totals): lizard-type about 69, orc-type about 139, spirit about 42, wolf about 33, bear about 34, skeleton about 30, ghost about 30, golem about 22, spider about 19, zombie about 17, beetle about 16, dragon about 15, drake about 11
Pets: 810 Pet-type NPC tags in stats/npcs; 53 pet data files in stats/pets (audit count)

top_creatures.label: Kill-site avenger (own label)
top_creatures.why: When a monster falls, a timed avenger spawns at that spot and hunts the killer or the killer's pet.
top_creatures.ref: L2Dn/L2Dn.GameServer.Scripts/AI/Areas/Cemetery.cs (OnKill, addSpawn 300000 ms); same pattern at AI/Areas/LairOfAntharasPytan.cs l.29 and AI/Areas/FieldOfMassacre.cs l.43

top_creatures.label: Companion-reactive hive (own label)
top_creatures.why: Hitting a companion triggers a random buff; killing a hive monster spawns a counter-monster after the killer.

top_creatures.label: Cursed relic (own label)
top_creatures.why: A relic with a stage-kill ladder that drops on the carrier's death and disappears after a timer.
top_creatures.ref: L2Dn/L2Dn.GameServer/DataPack/CursedWeapons.xml (fields stageKills, durationLost, dropRate, disapearChance, duration; 2 items)

top_creatures.label: Mounted beast form (own label)
top_creatures.why: Whole-body transform into a riding beast with its own action list.
top_creatures.change: Our own mount silhouette and controls

top_creatures.label: Absorb-to-evolve spirit (own label)
top_creatures.why: An elemental companion grows by absorbing items.
top_creatures.change: Our own element set and naming

top_creatures.label: Grand-boss tier (own label)
top_creatures.why: A rare top rung above a large raid-boss ladder.
top_creatures.change: Our own phase design (data only, not read in code)

top_creatures.label: Dragon-kin family (own label)
top_creatures.why: Winged-reptile family with its own tiers (keyword match only, approximate).
top_creatures.ref: L2Dn/L2Dn.GameServer/DataPack/stats/npcs/20100-20199.xml and 13500-13599.xml (keyword match; 13500-13599 is mostly NPC type Folk, check by hand)

top_creatures.label: Raid-boss ladder (own label)
top_creatures.why: A long run of raid bosses from level 20 to 90 gives steady escalation.

classes: Class tree: 99 entries in stats/chars/classList.xml linked by parentClassId; CharacterClass.cs has 50 enum values; not split into base and subclass
Example link: base fighter (classId 0) then promoted warrior (classId 1)
Races (Race.cs): playable races plus monster families (see creature_families); category-level only
Progression shape: class tree by parent link; race fixed at character creation (not read in code)
weapon_families: weapon_type counts (stats/items): blunt 587, sword 552, dual 315, dagger 220, pole 183, bow 153, dual fist 105, fist 59, rapier 57, ancient sword 55; others (crossbow, flag, dual dagger, fishing rod) not counted
Crystal grade tiers: D 843, C 769, B 549, A 756, S 66, none 144 (crystal_type attribute matches)
Special properties: elemental attributes (ElementalAttributeData.xml, imbue) and set bonuses via armour sets
Visual distinctness of tiers: not in the box
gear_tiers: Armour sets: 51 entries in stats/armorsets/Sets.xml; each lists required items and a skill granted at minimumPieces (2 or 3 in sample)
Armour types (armor_type attribute matches): heavy 271, light 177, magic 162, sigil 37, none 9 (shields)
Materials (material attribute matches): paper, fish, liquid, wood, leather, cloth, bronze, silver, steel, fine steel, mithril, rare top metal 142, gold 994, crystal 776

Enchant and grade: crystal grade letter and enchant level (EnchantItemOptions, EnchantItemGroups); augmentation options (stats/augmentation/options); ensoul (stats/ensoul/ensoulOptions.xml, ensoulStones.xml)
How the game shows tiers: grade letter and enchant level in data; client visuals not in the box
zones: Zone shapes (zones/documentation.txt): cuboid (2 points), polygon (3 or more points), cylinder (1 point plus radius); ZoneShape.cs

Zone types (ZoneType.cs): arena, boss, castle, clan hall, cleft, condition, damage, derby track, effect, fishing, fort, headquarters, jail, landing, mother tree, no-drop, no-landing, no-restart, no-PvP, no-store, no-summon, NPC territory, Olympiad stadium, peace, residence hall and residence teleport, respawn, script, siege, siegable hall, swamp, tax, territory war, town, water, Sayune, undying, teleport, timed hunting

Zone data: 2768 entries in zones/; shapes NPoly 2278, Cuboid 479; type values include ConditionZone 1070, WaterZone 425, EffectZone 218, RespawnZone 147, PeaceZone 136, ScriptZone 133, TaxZone 122; a second type attribute (chaotic 527, banish 156, other 532) not decoded
Instances: 9 named instance XML files in instances/ (e.g. MonsterArena.xml, SanctumOfLilith.xml, GoldbergsRoom.xml), plus Olympiad and custom folders
Residences: residences/castles and residences/clanHalls; timed hunting zones: TimedHuntingZoneData.xml
